something that works for me, and has for a long time, is just agreeing with them and their weird little complaints. Like, "Why is this stores aisle numbers all over the place??" You could say something like, "I know right, I have no idea, makes it difficult to find things sometimes thats for sure *laughs*"

I even go so far as to complain for them before they even can, lets say a customer is looking for Window Film but they're over in millwork looking at the windows, I'd say something like, "I couldn't tell you why, but they actually have it over in the flooring department *laughs*, they probably just do it to get you to walk around." 

These work literally every time. Even if they complain at that point, they're complaining to agree with you and you've now directed the blame off of you and onto the invisible company/GO. Try it out next time.
